o2.why: All three F4 panels are uniformly red with only black boundary lines and no second colour; the reader read the boundary network as etched lath texture in an optical micrograph.

o3.why: In F5c the grains below the interface (DZ(I)) are long and columnar and run steeply away from it, while F5a is irregular and equiaxed and F5b mixed; the reader swapped the HAZ and DZ(I) sides.

o5.why: F2a shows visibly finer lath contrast than the coarser blocks in F2b and the longer laths in F2c; the PQ technique and zone mapping are already source text with requires_unseen, so the reader's 'optical' guess is not a panel error.
